governing_scope: R2 only: initial geological state and necessary W01 stage-5 sampling; R3 and W03 evolution are not included

verification_families.T04: static formation/cooling identity and replacement inventories only; no migration/subduction evolution
verification_families.T05: initial E04 values and volume means only; no heat evolution or finite-plate completion
verification_families.T06: declared matrix/pore/solid volume conventions only; no compaction evolution
verification_families.T14: static mixed-support geometric/extensive invariants only; no coupled dynamics
verification_families.T15: self-contained initial-state/result restoration and stale-source rejection
verification_families.PT01-PT02: bounded concurrent readers, batching/order/prior stability; no process/device speed claim
verification_families.PT03-PT06: input/source identity, corrupt store, immutable arrays and finite shared admission
verification_families.PT09-PT11: cooperative interruption, cold restore and inherited lossless snapshot/dedup path
verification_families.PT13-PT14: existing execution identity, focused cold/prepared/restoration measurements; Linux only

family_note: Uses relevant unit/reference/conservation/reproducibility and execution/resource obligations of the maintained T/PT families; does not complete those whole families.

scientific_contract.geometry: Plate-independent planar area, conditioned spherical patch, or full framed sphere; computational supports do not determine physical plates
scientific_contract.vertical_structure: Ordered, surface-relative constant-depth columns and explicitly prioritised footprint/depth-band slab or mantle inputs
scientific_contract.time: SI seconds in a named epoch; formation and cooling histories are independent
scientific_contract.spherical_volume: A/R^2 * ((R-top)^3-(R-bottom)^3)/3; evaluated as a stable factored difference
scientific_contract.phases: explicit_pore_volume=bulk_volume*porosity; matrix_volume=bulk_volume*(1-porosity); constituent volume=matrix_volume*declared fraction; no renormalisation
scientific_contract.bulk_reference: Source-specific aggregate matrix volume is not certified true solid volume; adding explicit pores to it is refused
scientific_contract.mass: Optional source-reference-density mass at explicitly requested reference temperature; not in-situ hot/pressurised mass
scientific_contract.temperature: Initial point or volume-weighted mean temperature; not heat/enthalpy and not evolution
scientific_contract.prior: mean + amplitude/N * sum cos(k dot (r-origin) + phase); amplitude is maximum-deviation bound; wavelength is feature scale, not an inferred correlation length
scientific_contract.seed_stream: atlas.cosine-stream.v1: SHA256(name, uint64 seed, mode index); fixed top-53-bit uniforms; mesh-independent Cartesian coordinates
scientific_contract.weakness: Retained authored faults and exact point weak-zone/corridor membership; no invented damage or rheology

numerical_policy.geometry: Existing unsnapped minor-arc/GEOS geometry; no source movement, sliver removal or centre-point approximation of mixed-cell volume
numerical_policy.derivation: Inventory threshold is a declared binary64 overlay/summation diagnostic, not physical uncertainty. Analytical references and refinement must remain within it without modifying geometry. Thermal quadrature reports its estimate and refuses failures. Independent analytical tests use tighter case-specific bounds. These are new R2 policies, not relaxations of any retained tolerance.

unsupported: Arbitrary dipping/curved volumetric slab geometries or general 3D interpolation
Spherical cell averages of Cartesian spectral priors; spherical point evaluation and unperturbed radial profile means are supported
Automatic global disjoint-mesh certification across incompatible conditioned charts; incompatible support queries require explicit non-additive overlap opt-in or compatible patches
Hot/high-pressure density or thermal constitutive laws, stress solution, thermal evolution, physical plate formation, W01-to-W02 evolution workflow, global mantle spin-up

example.meaning: Illustrative authored continental/oceanic columns using sourced reference profiles; not an Earth-calibrated or mechanically equilibrated initial world
example.time_unit: million Julian years; 31557600000000 SI seconds each
example.intrinsic_aggregate_porosity: unresolved by the bulk-reference rock profiles; no true-solid volume claimed

acceptance_separation.implementation_and_numerical_checks: recorded separately in evidence/3cr2-tests.json and bounded sampling evidence
acceptance_separation.R1_source_use_and_strict_consistency: unchanged; no acquisition or source-policy modifications

bounded_execution_case.point_reference: independent per-point exhaustive GEOS membership and scalar layer lookup, same source geometry; verification only, not timed as a complete alternative backend
bounded_execution_case.native_timing_includes: context verification, inputs, native query, field evaluation, immutable output/hash creation; cold includes plan construction and close
bounded_execution_case.storage: single actual self-contained result snapshot in temporary Zstd ArrayStore; restore every numeric array exactly
